faqItems.question: How long does Invisalign take versus traditional braces?
faqItems.answer: While there's no set answer, many patients experience more comfortable treatment with 30% faster results compared to traditional methods, though individual treatment time varies based on complexity.

faqItems.question: How much does Invisalign cost, and is it covered by insurance?
faqItems.answer: The cost of orthodontic treatment varies based on case complexity, duration, and type of appliances. We offer customized payment plans and work with various insurance providers to make treatment affordable.

faqItems.question: How many hours a day do I have to wear my aligners?
faqItems.answer: The convenience of Invisalign allows you to easily take out the custom-fitted plastic aligners for eating, brushing, and flossing, making it superb for patients of all ages.

faqItems.question: Can Invisalign fix my specific bite issue?
faqItems.answer: Invisalign offers effective, discreet treatment perfect for addressing crowding, spacing, and bite correction, suitable for both teens and adults. A consultation will confirm its suitability for your case.

faqItems.question: Will Invisalign hurt or affect my speech?
faqItems.answer: Invisalign aligners are practically invisible and custom-fitted, providing a smooth and comfortable experience that typically doesn't cause self-consciousness or significant speech issues.

faqItems.question: What happens after treatment – do I need a retainer forever?
faqItems.answer: To maintain your beautiful new smile, custom retainers are essential after Invisalign treatment. We offer an Invisalign Retainer Subscription Program to help you maintain your smile for a lifetime.

doctor.name: Dr. David Alpan
doctor.bio: Dr. David Alpan is a top-rated orthodontist in Los Angeles and a third-generation dental professional, proudly continuing a legacy of excellence. Since founding Alpan Orthodontics in 1999, he has specialized in advanced treatments like Invisalign, LightForce, and TMJ therapy. As a top-tier Invisalign provider, Dr. Alpan has taught over 10,000 dentists and orthodontists worldwide. His philosophy is to treat every patient like family, creating smiles that function in harmony with the face and jaw.

reviews.name: Erin Gray
reviews.text: I had done a couple of other ortho consults elsewhere, but when I met Dr. Alpan and his staff, I knew that I was absolutely ready to move forward with treatment. They are incredibly kind and spent a significant amount of time with me to build out my treatment plan. Excited to get started!

reviews.name: La Angie Fuller
reviews.text: Dr. Alpan is the real deal. Top-notch technology, a friendly and professional team, and quick, efficient appointments make the whole experience easy. My smile has improved dramatically since starting Invisalign, and I actually look forward to my visits. Highly recommend Dr. Alpan if you want results and a smooth process.

reviews.name: goddess goddess
reviews.text: Fantastic service! Always on time and ready to greet me with warmth and care. Alpan orthodontics helped me relieve my jaw pain, neck and back pain as well. The TMJ treatment was really helpful. It elevated my discomfort and I am happy I chose Dr. Alpan to help me. Great staff and office. Highly recommend this practice for all your orthodontic needs.

reviews.name: Brett Ingber
reviews.text: Dr. Alpan and his team are professional and caring. Before my last appointment I called in because I wanted to come in earlier that day, and they made room for me. Dr. Alpan always listens to any concerns I had during my treatment; like when I was transitioning from Invisalign liners to Vivera retainers.

reviews.name: Vincent Vinuya
reviews.text: I actually had to get braces TWICE from this location because I didn't wear my retainers as a kid. I learned my lesson and I finished up my braces years ago. I purchased multiple pairs of Vivera retainers after my initial procedures. The office was still clean and organized how I remembered it. I would highly recommended Alpan Orthodontics.

reviews.name: Ray Bit
reviews.text: Went in for a scheduled 12-week examination. Met with an orthodontic assistant who examined my teeth, asked me relevant questions and added a small metal post. She also adjusted my retainer and entered notes into my chart. The doctor was equally skilled, knowledgeable and professional. Overall, my experience was very positive and promising.
